Service Overview

Roadside Assistance Dubai — Fast Triage & Emergency Breakdown Service

Unexpected car breakdowns across Dubai typically stem from three heat-related failures: sudden battery failure caused by severe under-hood heat soak, tyre punctures on superheated highway asphalt, or cooling system failure during stop-and-go traffic. Through Dubai Car Repair Service, you get rapid, dependable road assistance wherever you are stranded. If you need immediate dispatch, you can contact our emergency team directly.

Operating daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM from our workshop at 222 Al Satwa Road, our response units carry computerized diagnostic scanners, high-capacity jump packs, replacement batteries, and tyre repair kits. Whether you need an on-site dead battery replacement, an urgent tyre change near me, or on-demand dispatch from a mobile mechanic near me, we aim to get you moving again without a tow truck.

When severe mechanical issues occur—such as internal car engine repair in Dubai or transmission lockups—we safely coordinate flatbed recovery directly to our Al Satwa garage. Drivers stuck on major highway corridors can count on our dedicated roadside assistance on Sheikh Zayed Road unit for fast response to avoid dangerous shoulder stops.

Emergency Services

Roadside Assistance Services We Provide in Dubai

Common roadside breakdown scenarios we respond to -explaining what can be resolved on-site and when workshop recovery is required.

Battery Jump Start & Replacement

Resolved on-site

Rapid response for dead batteries caused by extreme Dubai heat or prolonged accessory drain. We use voltage-regulated booster packs to prevent voltage spikes to vehicle electronics. We perform on-site digital conductance load testing, and if the battery is depleted beyond recovery, we carry and install compatible AGM, EFB, or flooded batteries on the spot.

AED 60–100 jump start / From AED 180 with replacement [CONFIRM: roadside jump start and battery replacement rates]

Puncture Repair & Spare Wheel Fitting

Resolved on-site or spare fitted

On-site assessment of flat or punctured tyres. If the damage is limited to the central tread area, we perform permanent vulcanising plug-patch repairs. For sidewall blowouts, shoulder punctures, or rim damage, we fit your vehicle's spare tyre. If no usable spare is available, we coordinate workshop transfer or new tyre replacement.

AED 55–80 puncture repair [CONFIRM: roadside tyre puncture repair fee]

Engine Overheating Inspection

Triage on-site / Recovery if severe

Sudden engine overheating demands immediate shut-off to prevent warped cylinder heads or blown head gaskets. We inspect for ruptured radiator hoses, thermostat sticking, or coolant reservoir seal leaks. Minor hose tightening or coolant top-ups can be handled on-site; severe cooling system failures require flatbed recovery.

From AED 80 inspection [CONFIRM: roadside overheating inspection charge]

Vehicle Lockout Assistance

Resolved on-site

Non-destructive vehicle entry methods when keys are locked inside passenger cars. For modern luxury vehicles equipped with deadlocking electronic systems, our technicians verify accessibility and use specialized, non-damaging entry tools.

AED 100–180 [CONFIRM: vehicle lockout assistance pricing]

Emergency Fuel Delivery

Resolved on-site

Rapid delivery of petrol or diesel for motorists stranded with an empty tank. We verify your engine's exact fuel specification prior to dispatch to prevent misfuelling damage, delivering sufficient fuel to safely reach the nearest service station.

AED 80 call-out + fuel at pump price [CONFIRM: emergency fuel delivery fee]

Minor Roadside Electrical Faults

Depends on fault

On-site diagnosis for unexpected starter motor silence, alternator warning indicators, or blown main fuses immobilising critical circuits. Loose terminals and blown relays can be rectified roadside; deeper wiring harness faults require garage workshop equipment.

From AED 80 diagnostic + labour [CONFIRM: electrical diagnostic roadside fee]

Roadside OBD-II Diagnostic Scan

On-site assessment

Interrogation of powertrain (ECM), transmission (TCM), and ABS modules following sudden warning lights or limp-mode conditions. We read active diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) on-site to determine whether your car is mechanically safe to drive or requires towing.

AED 80–100 [CONFIRM: roadside OBD-II scan fee]

Vehicle Recovery & Flatbed Towing

Workshop recovery

When roadside repairs cannot safely resolve the breakdown—such as transmission failure, snapped drive belts, suspension collapse, or severe accident damage—we coordinate flatbed towing to our 222 Al Satwa Road workshop through vetted recovery partners.

AED 150–300 typical towing charge [CONFIRM: third-party towing rate structure]

Frequently Asked Questions

Roadside Assistance Dubai -Frequently Asked Questions

Move your vehicle to the hard shoulder or emergency lane as quickly and safely as possible. Switch on hazard warning lights immediately. If safe to do so, place a reflective warning triangle 50 metres behind the vehicle. Do not stand directly behind or in front of the car on active highway lanes; exit through the passenger side away from traffic and wait behind the safety crash barrier. Once in a secure position, call +971 56 612 1423 and provide your nearest road marker or green exit sign number so our team can dispatch assistance.

Roadside assistance involves on-site mechanical and electrical troubleshooting (jump starts, puncture repairs, spare wheel mounting, or emergency fuel) to get your car driving again without towing. Vehicle recovery involves winching or safely extracting an immobilised vehicle from sand, ditches, or tight parking basements. Car towing or flatbed recovery involves loading a mechanically disabled or unsafe vehicle onto a truck to transport it to our Al Satwa workshop.

Many comprehensive motor insurance policies and manufacturer warranties include roadside assistance coverage, but terms and response times vary significantly. Some policies only cover towing up to a certain kilometre limit, while others exclude battery replacement costs or have high deductibles. If your insurer has extended waiting periods or you need urgent mechanical assessment, Dubai Car Repair Service provides direct pay-as-you-go dispatch.

Dubai Car Repair Service provides roadside assistance during our confirmed workshop operating hours from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, including weekends and public holidays. For incidents occurring late at night outside these hours, we advise contacting RTA emergency assistance or your insurance provider's dedicated hotline. [CONFIRM: 24/7 emergency dispatch availability vs scheduled 7AM-10PM operating hours]

Most common roadside failures—including dead batteries, central tread punctures, fuel exhaustion, minor coolant loss, and basic electrical faults—are resolved directly at your location. If on-site testing reveals severe internal mechanical damage, seized brakes, transmission failure, or blown radiators, towing to our 222 Al Satwa Road workshop is necessary. We assess the fault first and explain all options transparently.

No. Never continue driving an overheated car. In Dubai's summer climate, driving with a pegged temperature gauge can warp aluminium cylinder heads, blow head gaskets, or seize engine pistons within minutes. Pull over immediately into a safe area, shut off the engine, pop the bonnet latch without opening a hot radiator cap, and call us for roadside assessment.
